_note: Default target angles match the stick-figure reference images (2D, front view unless stated). Run tools/record_pose.py to replace them with your own; that sets calibrated to true.

poses.name: Mountain Pose (Tadasana)
poses.instruction: Face the camera with your whole body in view. Stand tall, feet together, legs straight and arms resting by your sides.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Left knee is bent. Straighten your left leg.
joints.tip_high: Left knee is locked back. Soften it slightly.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Right knee is bent. Straighten your right leg.
joints.tip_high: Right knee is locked back. Soften it slightly.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: You are leaning or bending at the left hip. Stand up straight.
joints.tip_high: Left hip is pushed out. Bring your hips under your shoulders.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: You are leaning or bending at the right hip. Stand up straight.
joints.tip_high: Right hip is pushed out. Bring your hips under your shoulders.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Left arm is pressed in. Let it hang a little away from your body.
joints.tip_high: Left arm is lifted away. Lower it to your side.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Right arm is pressed in. Let it hang a little away from your body.
joints.tip_high: Right arm is lifted away. Lower it to your side.

poses.name: Chair Pose (Utkatasana)
poses.instruction: Turn sideways to the camera. With feet together, bend your knees and sit your hips back as if into a chair, and reach your arms up alongside your ears.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Knees are bent too deep. Rise up a little.
joints.tip_high: Knees are too straight. Bend your knees and sit back further.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Knees are bent too deep. Rise up a little.
joints.tip_high: Knees are too straight. Bend your knees and sit back further.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: You are folding forward too much. Lift your chest.
joints.tip_high: Torso is too upright. Lean forward slightly as your hips sit back.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: You are folding forward too much. Lift your chest.
joints.tip_high: Torso is too upright. Lean forward slightly as your hips sit back.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Arms are too low. Reach them up alongside your ears.
joints.tip_high: Arms are reaching too far back. Keep them in line with your torso.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Arms are too low. Reach them up alongside your ears.
joints.tip_high: Arms are reaching too far back. Keep them in line with your torso.

joints.name: left_elbow
joints.tip_low: Elbows are bent. Straighten your arms as you reach up.
joints.tip_high: Elbows are overextended. Soften them slightly.

joints.name: right_elbow
joints.tip_low: Elbows are bent. Straighten your arms as you reach up.
joints.tip_high: Elbows are overextended. Soften them slightly.

poses.name: Tree Pose (Vrikshasana)
poses.instruction: Face the camera. Stand on your right leg, place your left foot on your inner right thigh with the knee pointing out, and press your palms together overhead.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Standing right knee is bent. Straighten your standing leg.
joints.tip_high: Standing right knee is locked back. Soften it slightly.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: You are leaning over your standing hip. Stand up tall.
joints.tip_high: Standing hip is pushed out to the side. Center your weight.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Left knee is folded too tightly. Let the foot rest higher on your thigh.
joints.tip_high: Left knee is not bent enough. Draw your left foot up to your inner thigh.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: Left knee is too far out or raised. Let it drop toward the floor.
joints.tip_high: Left knee is pointing down or forward. Open it out to the side.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Left arm is too low. Reach your arms up overhead.
joints.tip_high: Left arm is reaching too far over. Keep your arms above your head.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Right arm is too low. Reach your arms up overhead.
joints.tip_high: Right arm is reaching too far over. Keep your arms above your head.

poses.name: Goddess Pose (Utkata Konasana)
poses.instruction: Face the camera with feet wide apart and toes turned out. Bend both knees out over your toes, and lift your elbows to shoulder height with your hands pointing up.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Left knee is bent too far. Rise up a little.
joints.tip_high: Left knee is too straight. Bend it and sink your hips.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Right knee is bent too far. Rise up a little.
joints.tip_high: Right knee is too straight. Bend it and sink your hips.

joints.name: left_elbow
joints.tip_low: Left elbow is folded in too far. Point your left forearm straight up.
joints.tip_high: Left arm is too straight. Bend the elbow so your forearm points up.

joints.name: right_elbow
joints.tip_low: Right elbow is folded in too far. Point your right forearm straight up.
joints.tip_high: Right arm is too straight. Bend the elbow so your forearm points up.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Left elbow has dropped. Lift it to shoulder height.
joints.tip_high: Left elbow is too high. Lower it to shoulder height.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Right elbow has dropped. Lift it to shoulder height.
joints.tip_high: Right elbow is too high. Lower it to shoulder height.

poses.name: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
poses.instruction: Face the camera with feet wide apart. Bend your right knee over your right ankle, keep your left leg straight, and stretch both arms out at shoulder height.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Right knee is bent too much. Ease up so the knee stays over the ankle.
joints.tip_high: Right knee is not bent enough. Sink deeper into your front leg.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Left knee is bent. Straighten your back leg.
joints.tip_high: Left knee is locked back. Soften it slightly.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Left arm is too low. Raise it to shoulder height.
joints.tip_high: Left arm is too high. Lower it to shoulder height.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Right arm is too low. Raise it to shoulder height.
joints.tip_high: Right arm is too high. Lower it to shoulder height.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: You are leaning toward your front leg. Keep your torso upright over your hips.
joints.tip_high: Your front leg is too straight. Sink your hips until the front thigh is nearly level with the floor.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: You are leaning toward your back leg. Keep your torso upright over your hips.
joints.tip_high: Your torso is leaning toward your front leg. Stack your shoulders over your hips.

poses.name: Triangle Pose (Trikonasana)
poses.instruction: Face the camera with feet wide apart and both legs straight. Tip your upper body over your left leg, rest your left hand on your shin, and reach your right arm straight up.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Left knee is bent. Straighten your front leg.
joints.tip_high: Left knee is locked back. Soften it slightly.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Right knee is bent. Straighten your back leg.
joints.tip_high: Right knee is locked back. Soften it slightly.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: You are folding too far forward. Lengthen your torso sideways.
joints.tip_high: You are too upright. Tip your torso further over your left leg.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: Your top hip is collapsing. Open your right hip toward the camera.
joints.tip_high: You are too upright. Tip your torso further over your left leg.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Left arm is tucked in. Let it hang straight down to your shin.
joints.tip_high: Left arm is reaching forward. Let it hang straight down to your shin.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Right arm is not reaching up. Stretch it straight toward the ceiling.
joints.tip_high: Right arm is reaching back too far. Stack it above your shoulder.

poses.name: Downward Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana)
poses.instruction: Turn sideways to the camera. Hands and feet on the floor, lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V, arms and legs straight.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: Hips are folded too tightly. Walk your hands forward a little.
joints.tip_high: Hips are too low. Lift your hips up and back.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: Hips are folded too tightly. Walk your hands forward a little.
joints.tip_high: Hips are too low. Lift your hips up and back.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Knees are bent. Press your heels toward the floor to straighten your legs.
joints.tip_high: Knees are locked back. Soften them slightly.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Knees are bent. Press your heels toward the floor to straighten your legs.
joints.tip_high: Knees are locked back. Soften them slightly.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Shoulders are hunched. Push the floor away and bring your arms in line with your back.
joints.tip_high: Chest is sinking toward the floor. Lift through your shoulders.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Shoulders are hunched. Push the floor away and bring your arms in line with your back.
joints.tip_high: Chest is sinking toward the floor. Lift through your shoulders.

poses.name: Child's Pose (Balasana)
poses.instruction: Turn sideways to the camera, with the camera low. Kneel, sit back on your heels, rest your forehead on the floor and stretch your arms forward.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Knees are folded very tightly. Make sure you are comfortable on your heels.
joints.tip_high: You are not sitting back. Sink your hips toward your heels.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Knees are folded very tightly. Make sure you are comfortable on your heels.
joints.tip_high: You are not sitting back. Sink your hips toward your heels.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: Hips are folded very tightly. Ease off a little.
joints.tip_high: Your chest is lifted. Fold forward and rest your chest on your thighs.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: Hips are folded very tightly. Ease off a little.
joints.tip_high: Your chest is lifted. Fold forward and rest your chest on your thighs.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Arms are not reaching forward. Stretch them out in front of you on the floor.
joints.tip_high: Arms are reaching too high. Rest them on the floor in front of you.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Arms are not reaching forward. Stretch them out in front of you on the floor.
joints.tip_high: Arms are reaching too high. Rest them on the floor in front of you.

poses.name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandha Sarvangasana)
poses.instruction: Turn sideways to the camera, with the camera low. Lie on your back, feet flat near your hips, and lift your hips into a straight line from shoulders to knees.

joints.name: left_knee
joints.tip_low: Feet are too close to your hips. Walk them out a little.
joints.tip_high: Feet are too far away. Walk them toward your hips so your shins are upright.

joints.name: right_knee
joints.tip_low: Feet are too close to your hips. Walk them out a little.
joints.tip_high: Feet are too far away. Walk them toward your hips so your shins are upright.

joints.name: left_hip
joints.tip_low: Hips are too low. Press into your feet and lift your hips.
joints.tip_high: Hips are pushed too high. Lower them a little so shoulders, hips and knees are in line.

joints.name: right_hip
joints.tip_low: Hips are too low. Press into your feet and lift your hips.
joints.tip_high: Hips are pushed too high. Lower them a little so shoulders, hips and knees are in line.

joints.name: left_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Arms are lifted off the floor. Rest them flat beside you.
joints.tip_high: Arms are reaching up. Lay them flat on the floor beside you, palms down.

joints.name: right_shoulder
joints.tip_low: Arms are lifted off the floor. Rest them flat beside you.
joints.tip_high: Arms are reaching up. Lay them flat on the floor beside you, palms down.
